title: Value list with hard-coded values
description: Code-style rule — value lists built from custom (hard-coded) values instead of a field. Hard-coded lists drift out of date and cannot be edited by users.
author: fm-lab rules

rule.rationale: Hard-coded value lists duplicate data and require a developer to change.
rule.remediation: Base the value list on a field / table so it stays current and user-editable.
